test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"boarded."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Boarded"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it fits the context of transportation (i.e. getting on a bus, train, plane, etc.).
 
• The word **"boarded"** means to get on a plane, ship, bus, etc. (विमान, जहाज़, बस आदि में सवार होना)
 
 
• **Example**: *We said goodbye and **boarded**__ the train.*
 
 
 
• ​So, the correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage*:*

Dill ate, and ate and ate. He hadn’t eaten __since__ last night. He used all his money for a ticket, __**boarded**__ the train, as he had done many times, coolly chatted with the conductor, to ______ (3) ______ Dill was a familiar sight, but he had not the nerve to invoke the rule on small children travelling a distance alone; if you’ve lost your money the conductor will ______ (4) ______ you enough for dinner and your father will ______ (5) ______ him back at the end of the line. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Climbed: **to move up towards the top of something. ((पेड़, पहाड़ आदि पर) चढ़ना)
 
• **Ran: **to move using your legs, going faster than a walk. (दौड़ना (टाँगों के सहारे, चलने से अधिक तेज़ गति करना))
 
• **Walked: **to move or go somewhere by putting one foot in front of the other on the ground, but without running. ((व्‍यक्ति का) चलना)
